title: Hands and vigilance microbreak
summary: Two-minute physical and visual reset after borderline reaction drift or long fine-motor work.

steps.text: Pause precision control work and rest your forearms loosely.
Slowly spread and relax your fingers ten times without gripping.
Rotate both wrists gently in slow circles for 20 seconds.
Rest your eyes on a distant cabin point and breathe slowly for 60 seconds.
